sources.citation: Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendajú (etnolinguistica.org): Pano tag list, theses index, site search
sources.note: No Kulina Pano item among Pano-tagged resources; site search offline; no page for an Oliveira 2014 thesis.

sources.citation: Oliveira, Sanderson Castro Soares de. 2016. Consoantes em final de palavra em Proto-Páno. Fragmentum 46. doi:10.5902/fragmentum.v0i46.23391
sources.note: Discusses final-syllable stress in Kashibo, Shipibo-Konibo and Kapanawa as evidence for Proto-Pano final consonants; Kulina Pano is not mentioned anywhere in the article.

sources.citation: Fleck, David W. 2013. Panoan Languages and Linguistics. Anthropological Papers of the American Museum of Natural History 99. New York: AMNH. 112 pp. doi:10.5531/sp.anth.0099
sources.note: Nothing on stress for any language (only orthographic remark p. 11: 'all stress marks are left out'). For Kulina of the Curuçá River (= Kulina Pano, three dialects Kapishtana, Mawi, Chema) the documentation list on pp. 93-94 gives: 'Fleck (in prep.) phonology, grammar, and 400-word lexica of all three dialects'; Fleck (2010) grammatical study; Fleck (2007a) historical and lexical study; Fields (1970) unpublished SIL lexica; Jakway (1975) partial copies; Coutinho (1998) 60 words; Fleck & Voss (2006) 51 animal names.

sources.citation: Fleck, David W. 2007. Did the Kulinas become the Marubos? A linguistic and ethnohistorical investigation. Tipití 5(2): 137-207.
sources.note: Comparative wordlists and ethnohistory; identifies the three Kulina dialects (pp. 157-158); no phonology section and no stress statement (the one 'accent' hit, p. 172, is about Portuguese speakers).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record for kuli1255 (JSON) and reference page
sources.note: No stress information. MEDs: Fleck 2010 (phonology_or_text, 18 pp), Fleck & Voss 2006, Jakway 1975 (wordlist). Subclassification refs: Fleck 2013, Soares de Oliveira 2023.

sources.citation: Fleck, David W. 2010. Ergativity in the Mayoruna branch of the Panoan family. In Spike Gildea & Francesc Queixalós (eds.), Ergativity in Amazonia (TSL 89), 29-64. Amsterdam: Benjamins.

Unpublished; underlying recordings archived at ELAR ('Documentation of the Mayoruna languages of western Amazonia', ELDP MDP, 2010-2013).

sources.note: The only phonological description of Kulina Pano that exists according to Fleck 2013; the author is the sole linguist with first-hand Kulina Pano data. Worth asking Fleck directly whether a phonology sketch (with stress) exists in manuscript.
